from.description: Index the window starts at, clamped to total

items.description: The window, strictly newest first: index 0 is the most recent delivery and the last item the oldest

total.description: Records matching the filter, of which the window is one page

written.description: Records stored since the log started, so a reader can tell the ring overwrote what it had not read
